Detailed Description

This class provides support for reading an NITF image segment. NITFImageManager objects are not to be created directly; the NITFImageManager class contains a createReader() function for this purpose.

THIS CLASS SUBJECT TO SIGNIFICANT CHANGE IN SUBSEQUENT RELEASES.
